findings.current: Someone had once said there was beauty in the sight of a person who had given their all.
findings.defect: The source specifically describes the person's back (뒷모습); the English generalizes this to their overall sight, losing the image preserved in the accepted baseline.
findings.rationale: The Korean says “최선을 다한 자의 뒷모습은 아름답다고”—that the back of someone who gave their all is beautiful.
findings.replacement: Someone had once said there was beauty in the back of a person who had given their all.

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with one lost source-specific image.
